label: Consolidation of the restated premises reported by the #1926 survey
summary: Issue #1926 phase 2, slice 1. QUESTION: do the premises the #1926 survey reported as restatements coincide in sense, quantifier, world and carrier, and how can coinciding ones be consolidated without deleting or merging records? FINDINGS. (1) 732302a1 (q.44 a.1 co.) and 2b25a78c (q.44 a.1 ad 1) are the same proposition over the same parameters, by Iff.rfl (participatedCauseReadingsIff). Both link ESSE_BY_PARTICIPATION_1 and esse, and in both the cause is mode-unspecified. Registered logically_equivalent_to. merged_legacy_ids is rejected: the records bind different Lean declarations in frozen Challenges, and their source readings differ. (2) 22954087 (MeditatorThinks I) is b0fd6cc1 (SelectedBearsOccurringThought) at the idea frame's occurrence, bearing and meditator fields, by Iff.rfl (meditatorThinksIff). Registered logically_equivalent_to; the equivalence holds at that instantiation. (3) c76b6e2c (frame) is c94b5446 on the frame's ground profile for any grounding relation, by Iff.rfl (someContingentConcreteIff). Registered logically_equivalent_to. The c94b5446 record reads the concreteness parameter as CONCRETE_6; c76b6e2c leaves it open. No other premise states that some concrete contingent exists: the survey's other candidates state the possibility of absence (18e5bd4e, 0dc833c1) or are about a power holder. (4) The twelve 'power for joint absence' premises are not restatements. Most state different properties of the holder (existence b517ca3e, concreteness a6906cab, one power 9856239a, invariant set-up a065c332, giving each 9f7b1778, power over esse f0ac2f76, differing exercise 5cf75a6b, GOD_4 holds it 0050b6ed). Nine bare premises instantiate three single-proposition schemas of ModalGrounding (grounding, initiator presence, holders concrete) at three propositions (global absence, the actual contingents' absence, w obtaining at absence worlds). The new statement 31d9564c states Aristotelian modality at every world. It is registered as strengthening P1-prime 95bf8780 (result 89359310) and 607e94cf (result b66f2424), both declared instantiation transcriptions. The controls result 554f060b gives a three-world separator with contingent concreta: P1-prime (non-vacuously), 607e94cf and 94393b5b hold there and the universal fails. It also shows the universal is satisfiable on that frame. (5) The duplicate argument groups (784f2278/aff41a69, 12865cf3/ba458489, fe08da3c/660673ca) are not identical records. Each carrier argument instantiates its parametric sibling at a sense carrier, as the one-argument-per-sense rule requires. The love corollaries a66e4ce3 and 54a9ccd9 now declare transcription kind instantiation, like the cogito one 39454df8; closure is unchanged because the parametric siblings derive the same conclusions from the same premises. (6) The assertion (b45ca9db), doubt (95c5138f) and thinking (b0fd6cc1/22954087) occurrence premises use disjoint primitives and none entails another. Each reaches 'some thought episode occurs' (e81971f1) by its own argument (3f9339f0; 7d7b89e7 or 187646ad; f93f2dfd), the first through the existing strength order and the others through different open realization bridges. They are three premises for one conclusion, not one assumption; nothing was registered. COMPUTED EFFECT: truth frontier-diff against 61acfd56 adds 31d9564c as a bare premise and shows no other change. Equivalence and instance registrations are not read by the frontier, and an instantiation transcription with an open premise closes and expands nothing. So the restated premises still count separately in the route diagnostics. Making them count once needs a rule change (a frontier view that quotients premises by verified equivalence, phase 4). REMAINING (not done, 30-file limit): strengthens from the universal to 94393b5b; universals for initiator presence and holder concreteness with their six instances; the strength order 5cf75a6b to 906f5c39 (exercise that differs in giving adds to initiator presence; 61e207fc uses 5cf75a6b where 259571ae uses 906f5c39).
